description: This file provides utility functions for string formatting, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case for use in the application's UI. The functions handle normalization of whitespace, delimiters, and special characters, and are designed to ensure consistent string presentation throughout the application.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespace. Returns the original value if it is not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, replacing delimiters with spaces, collapsing whitespace, and capitalizing appropriately. Preserves apostrophes and accented characters.
